description: Source code for MPS (Metal Performance Shaders) profiling in PyTorch, including classes and methods for logging, signposting, and capturing GPU execution details on Apple hardware.

classes.name: BaseInfo
classes.description: Represents basic profiling information with methods for string representation and tensor string building.

classes.name: OperationInfo
classes.description: Holds details about a specific operation, including its type, ID, run count, and string key.

classes.name: CpuFbInfo
classes.description: Contains profiling info for CPU fallback operations, including overhead and timing.

classes.name: CopyInfo
classes.description: Stores details about memory copy operations, including source/destination keys and size.

classes.name: MPSProfiler
classes.description: Main class managing Metal Performance Shaders profiling, signposting, capturing, and stats logging.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a formatted string of GPU and CPU times.

methods.name: buildTensorString
methods.description: Builds a string representation of a tensor, optionally including buffer ID.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string describing an operation with timing info.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string for CPU fallback info with timing and overhead.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string describing a copy operation with size and type.

methods.name: buildTensorString
methods.description: Builds a string for a buffer or tensor, indicating whether it's on MPS or CPU.

methods.name: MPSProfiler
methods.description: Constructor initializing logging and signposting based on environment variables.

methods.name: StartTrace
methods.description: Begins signpost tracing with specified modes ('interval', 'event').

methods.name: StopTrace
methods.description: Stops signpost tracing.

methods.name: beginProfileExecution
methods.description: Starts profiling for a given operation info, including signposting.

methods.name: endProfileExecution
methods.description: Ends profiling for an operation, logs info, and emits signposts.

methods.name: beginProfileKernel
methods.description: Starts profiling a kernel or operation handle, returns profile ID.

methods.name: beginProfileKernel
methods.description: Overloaded: starts profiling with kernel name and tensors.

methods.name: beginProfileGPUInterval
methods.description: Begins GPU interval signposting for a handle.

methods.name: endProfileKernel
methods.description: Ends profiling for a kernel handle.

methods.name: beginProfileCPUFallback
methods.description: Starts profiling a CPU fallback operation.

methods.name: endProfileCPUFallback
methods.description: Ends profiling a CPU fallback operation.

methods.name: beginProfileCopy
methods.description: Starts profiling a memory copy operation, returns copy ID.

methods.name: endProfileCopy
methods.description: Ends profiling a copy operation.

methods.name: addProfilerScheduledHandler
methods.description: Adds a signpost for scheduled GPU command buffer execution.

methods.name: updateCopyStats
methods.description: Updates statistics for copy operations.

methods.name: addProfilerCompletedHandler
methods.description: Handles completion of a GPU command buffer, logs timing, and signposts.

methods.name: logOperationsProfilingStats
methods.description: Logs profiling stats for operations.

methods.name: logCPUFallbackProfilingStats
methods.description: Logs profiling stats for CPU fallback operations.

methods.name: logCopyProfilingStats
methods.description: Logs copy operation profiling statistics.

methods.name: logProfilingStats
methods.description: Logs all profiling stats at shutdown.

methods.name: isProfileInfoLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if info logging is enabled for a given info type and execution state.

methods.name: emitSignpostEvent
methods.description: Emits a signpost event for a specific operation type.

methods.name: beginSignpostInterval
methods.description: Begins a signpost interval for a specific operation type.

methods.name: endSignpostInterval
methods.description: Ends a signpost interval.

methods.name: generateSignpostId
methods.description: Generates a signpost ID, optionally with a pointer.

methods.name: getSignpostType
methods.description: Returns the signpost type for a given info type.

methods.name: handleIntSignal
methods.description: Handles SIGINT to log profiling stats.

methods.name: isCapturing
methods.description: Returns whether capture is active.

methods.name: isCaptureEnabled
methods.description: Checks if GPU capture is supported.

methods.name: startCapture
methods.description: Starts GPU capture with a given name and stream.

methods.name: stopCapture
methods.description: Stops GPU capture.
